title.narrative: Support to the European Endowment for Democracy - 2022

description.narrative: The European Commission has decided to finance the core functioning of the European Endowment for Democracy (EED) for the period 2019-2021. The support takes the form of annual operating grants to be renewed each year. The contract covers the year 2022 with AAP2021 funding for a total sum of funds come from NDICI-GEO-NEAR South (2,5 MEUR) and NDICI-GEO-NEAR East (3 MEUR) instruments.

title.narrative: Country score according to the Electoral Democracy Index developed by VDem

description.narrative: VDem distinguishes among 7 highlevel principles of democracy: electoral, liberal, participatory, majoritarian, consensual, deliberative and egalitarian, which are then further disaggregated into lowerlevels of democracy such as regular elections, direct democracy, gender equality and others. VDem Democracy Indices and Indicators include macrolevel indices that describe features of democracy at various levels (overall, midlevel and lowerlevel indices), as well as indicators that address very specific features of political systems.

comment.narrative: The data for all countries in which EED operates can be accessed by the link httpswww.vdem.netdata Since the baseline data as an example was provided for Ukraine Liberal democracy index the current value refers to Liberal democracy index for Ukraine 2022 based on VDem Democracy Report 2023.Due to the technical issues in the system the baseline and target value were integer numbers e.g. 32 instead of 0.32. Therefore the current value is also indicated as an integer number being 23 instead of 0.23.
